title: Fortuity and Complexity in a Simple Quark Model
summary: We observe and elaborate on a structural similarity between the categorization of monotone and fortuitous BPS operators in supersymmetric theories and gauge invariant quark operators in $SU(N_c)$ QCD. Our designation of fortuity does not rely on supersymmetry and instead uses the BRST cohomology. We argue that within this designation, baryon states are fortuitous while meson states are monotone.
